svg.text: scale comes from your ruler, not from this page
CALIBRATION LANE - keep clear of cores
10 mm comb: 17 marks, 160 mm baseline. 50 mm comb is a second pitch - if the two disagree, print or lens is at fault.
PRINTED CROSS-CHECK - not used for scale
printed cross-check only - not used for scale
mm per black/white pair - the finest group the app can still resolve is the true limit at the core's distance
1 Lay the plastic ruler across the top lane. Any straight ruler with 1 mm graduations works.
2 The app measures the ruler's millimetre graduations, not this card, for scale.
3 Ruler origin does not matter: only the graduation pitch is used. Edge and 0 mark may differ.
4 Place one core per bay, A to E. Keep the core off the top lane entirely.
5 Align the ruler's long edge with the table edge so every photo is shot the same way.
6 This card's 100 mm bar is a drift check only. It is printed, so it may be inaccurate.
Bar period, mm - do NOT scale to fit. Matte paper only.
v3: scale is measured from a physical ruler. A printed card cannot be its own reference - this one printed 7% small.
